reviews.text: Before I met Ms. Victoria of Victoria’s Tutoring Service LLC. I did not know how I was going to help my grandson with his math. He would not even ask his math teacher for help. Since Ms Victoria has been working with my grandson, his confidence has gone through the roof. He’s raising his hand and asking questions in math class. I am so excited to be apart of Victoria’s Tutoring Service LLC. Ms Victoria is a very kind, patient person, her quality of helping my grandson goes on match. If you need help with your children or grandchildren, you do not have to suffer alone seek out Victoria‘s Tutoring Service LLC for All of your Educational needs. Thank you Ms. V your Rock
reviews.author: Tina Clark

reviews.text: My daughter started tutoring services with Vicki almost a year ago now at the time she was in the 6th grade. She struggled in Math and LA as well as low motivation and self esteem when it came to academics. Needless to say this placed a strain on me and my daughters relationship. Then Victoria’s Tutoring Services was referred to me by a friend who had also used her services. When I met her I liked that she was not only concerned about my daughters academic suyccess but her self esteem and outlook on education all together. My daughters grades have taken a complete 360 along with her spirits and I know a great deal of that is contributed to the work and support that Vicki has provided through her services. Vicki is reasonable, professional and always on time! We know we can count on her!
reviews.author: Nyelle Johnson

reviews.text: I love Victoria's tutoring Service, it gave my son Yaasir the boost and confidence he needed to succeed in his math class. Ms Vicky showed and out pour of support by giving math drills, weekend work ups to help encourage his journey!
reviews.author: Latosha Allen

reviews.text: After attending a few hours of tutoring session with Mrs Vicky, I notice my son start to enjoy learning again. Having fun reading and solving Math problem on his own. He also looks forward to his visits twice a week. I do appreciate having services like this around, not that my kid was failing but just to keep him sharp and above the curve. I plan on continuing services thru the summer months.....hope I can get a discount Mrs Vicky lol.
reviews.author: Philly Philly

reviews.text: Victoria Tutoring Services (VTS) was recommended to me by a mutual friend. VTS has been tutoring and supporting my daughter in Math for over a year now. I absolutely love that she comes into my home and that my daughter has one on one time. It has helped to build confidence and a better understanding of math. I am eternally grateful for VTS and all that this service does and provides towards the needs of my daughter.
reviews.author: Sheila Pearson Anderson

Victoria Urban Outreach Tutoring Service (VUOTS) provides free, community-based academic support to individuals across Philadelphiabridging gaps, building confidence, and creating opportunity.WHY THIS WORK MATTERSAcross Philadelphia, too many students are navigating an education system that is under-resourced and inconsistent. Literacy gaps, school closures, and limited access to academic support continue to impact students and families across the city.Education should not depend on zip code—but for many, it still does.THE REALITY IN PHILADELPHIA Thousands of students face reading and math proficiency gaps School closures have disrupted community learning environments Many families lack access to consistent, individualized academic support These challenges are real—but so is the opportunity to respond. WHERE VUOTS STEPS INVUOTS exists to stand in that gap.We provide free tutoring and academic support designed to meet students where they are—while building confidence, consistency, and long-term success.Our work is rooted in: Academic support Mentorship Community connection Culturally responsive learning WHY SECONDARY SUPPORT MATTERSLearning does not stop when the school day ends.For many students, the classroom alone is not enough. Secondary support—tutoring, mentorship, and community-based programs—helps reinforce learning, address gaps, and provide the individualized attention students need to thrive.VUOTS ensures that support exists—consistently and intentionally. OUR WORK IN ACTIONOUR WORK IN ACTIONOUR WORK IN ACTIONVUOTS works directly in communities, schools, and partnerships to provide: Free tutoring services Educational workshops (civic engagement, storytelling, Black history) Youth mentorship and internship opportunities Community-centered programming and advocacy MORE THAN TUTORINGOUR WORK IN ACTIONOUR WORK IN ACTIONVUOTS is not just a tutoring service.We are building spaces where students: feel seen feel supported believe in their ability to succeed Because when students are supported, communities are strengthened.CALL TO ACTIONOUR WORK IN ACTIONCALL TO ACTIONGet Involved With VUOTSWhether you're a parent, student, educator, or organization, there are ways to connect with our work.[ Register for Tutoring ] [ Bring VUOTS to Your School ] [ Support Our Work ] VUOTS Upcoming Events Join Us VUOTS will be at Temple Made fest 2026 VUOTS Upcoming EngagementsJoin Us Healing
